title: Shift transport of the single-complex derived unit to degree zero
statement: Let B and C be abelian categories with chosen derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and assume B has enough injectives. Let G : B → C be additive, X : B and n : ℕ. Put S = single_n X as a bounded-below cochain complex, GS = G(S), and let e : single_n X ≅ Q(S) be the canonical singleFunctorIsoCompQ composed with quotientCompQhIso inverse and lifted through the full inclusion. Let c : H^n(RG(single_n(-))) ≅ H^0(RG(single_0(-))) be the three-factor shift transport: inverse singleFunctors.shiftIso at -n, the RG.commShiftIso at -n, and the H^0 homology shift comparison. Then homologyπ(GS,n) followed by homologyFunctorObjQIso(GS,n) inverse, H^n of the derived unit on S, H^n(RG(e inverse)), and c.hom at X equals iCycles(GS,n) followed by G(singleObjXSelf.hom) and the degree-zero map rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology G X defined in [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison].

Reassociate and unfold rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology, which is the inverse degree-zero single homology comparison followed by H^0 of rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit.

theorem rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit_canonical_single_shift (X : B) (n : ℕ) :
    let S : CochainComplex.Plus B :=
      ⟨(CochainComplex.singleFunctor B (n : ℤ)).obj X, n, inferInstance⟩
    let e : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B n).obj X ≅
        DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj S :=
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimageIso
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ B n).app X ≪≫
          (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso B).symm.app _)
    let GS := G.mapCochainComplexPlus.obj S
    let H₀ := DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C 0
    let RG := G.rightDerivedFunctorPlus
    let c := Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctors B).shiftIso (-(n : ℤ)) n 0 (by simp)).symm
      (RG ⋙ H₀.shift (n : ℤ)) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B 0)
        (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (RG.commShiftIso (-(n : ℤ))) (H₀.shift (n : ℤ))) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B 0 ⋙ RG)
        (H₀.shiftIso (-(n : ℤ)) (n : ℤ) 0 (by ring))
    GS.obj.homologyπ n ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctorObjQIso GS n).inv ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C n).map
        (G.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient B).obj S)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C n).map (G.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map e.inv) ≫
      c.hom.app X =
    GS.obj.iCycles n ≫
      G.map (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n X).hom ≫
      G.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology X
